detail: Both git status and git diff printed fatal: this operation must be run in a work tree. The wrapper ended exit0 after reading the frozen interface, so no git success is inferred. No mutation or blind retry occurred. .git was read back in e42622; no GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE override was printed. Exact pinned Main/candidate files were compared with difflib instead.

One of the four first Node failures was a plain mock ACK object where actual wire-values.reify requires a typed tree. Readbacks a8d920/2806bd/99efb6 established the mismatch. The original fixture, log and result remain intact. A separate attempt02 changes only the child mock output to a typed ACK tree; replay then passes and all three source counterexamples still fail.
Four malformed exact-key/case-variant replies were accepted and each reached one fake HTTP send. These are intentional negative assertions exposing a source bug, not test-harness failures.
